name: Palatial Servitors Swatch
desc: A color swatch employed by the palace servants of Arrakeen. Servants, yes, but the loftiest of the servile class.

name: Resplendent Seraph Ornithopter Swatch
desc: A bright white color swatch for ornithopters.

name: Sunset Dye Global Swatch
desc: A swatch that can be applied to all customizable objects.

desc: A variant of Asterion's End, used to customize swords or rapiers.

name: Asterion's End Variant
desc: A variant of Asterion's End, used to customize swords or rapiers.

name: Asteroid Harvester Heavy Pistol
desc: The Yafeng Water Shipper family wrangles asteroids from space, bringing them to their facility at Wind Pass, to harvest water and rare minerals. To protect this very expensive investment, the Yafeng family arms their guards with the most practical of weapons.

name: Asteroid Harvester Maula Pistol
desc: The Yafeng Water Shipper family wrangles asteroids from space, bringing them to their facility at Wind Pass, to harvest water and rare minerals. To protect this very expensive investment, the Yafeng family arms their guards with the most practical of weapons.

name: Atreides Battle Rifle
desc: A rifle variant that incorporates Atreides colors and logos.

name: B.E.T.A. Sword
desc: Handed to those who know the pain of broken worlds, desynched characters, disappearing vehicles and the eternal hunt for Skorda. We salute you.

name: CHOAM Tech Pistol
desc: A lightweight pistol given to those loyal to CHOAM.

name: CHOAM Tech Rifle
desc: A lightweight rifle given to those loyal to CHOAM.

name: CHOAM Tech SMG
desc: A lightweight smg given to those loyal to CHOAM.

name: CHOAM Tech Sword
desc: A lightweight blade given to those loyal to CHOAM.

name: Confederate Mk1
desc: Introduced during Ix’s post-war cooperation between House Vernius and the ascendant Technocrat Council, the Confederate Mk1 combines refined Vernius craftsmanship with the modular engineering philosophy that later defined the Ixian Confederacy.

name: Contraband Drillshot Variant
desc: A Contraband-themed variant of the Drillshot.

name: Contraband Pyrocket Variant
desc: A Contraband-themed variant, used to customize Pyrockets.

name: Contraband Snubnose Variant
desc: A Contraband-themed variant of the Snubnose, used to customize heavy pistols.

name: Elacca Wood-Accented Rifle
desc: A customization for rifles accented with luxurious elacca wood, for those with rarefied tastes.

name: Elacca Wood-Accented SMG
desc: A customization for SMGs accented with luxurious elacca wood, for those with rarefied tastes.

name: Harkonnen Enforcer Karpov
desc: A Harkonnen Enforcer variant of the Karpov rifle, used to customize battle rifles.

name: Kirab LMG Variant
desc: LMG Customization is the style of the Kirab

name: Makeshift Plaz Knife
desc: A glass shard visual for short blades.

name: Richese Elite
desc: Known for their specialty with sophisticated and miniaturized technology, House Richese has produced a maula pistol containing fine, intricate workings and smooth action. They call this much-desired weapon the Elite.

name: Sandflies Flamethrower Variant
desc: Flamethrower Customization is the style of the Sandflies

name: Sandflies Kindjal Variant
desc: Knife Customization is the style of the Sandflies

name: Sardaukar Benediction
desc: A blessing delivered with Imperial certainty.

name: Sardaukar Oathblade
desc: The oath is remembered long after the warrior is forgotten.

name: Smuggler Kindjal Variant
desc: A Smuggler-style customization that can be applied to knives.

name: The Frameblade
desc: A possibly corrupted spelling of the word Fremen, the Frameblade is a <Unique>Unique</> knife with a flawed design. Under heavy load, it will cut itself in half.

name: Vivisectionist’s Bone Saw
desc: The rumors of horrific experiments being conducted in the Old Quarry are only given more credence by the appearance of such grim tools. The miraculous blade maintains its edge even after cutting through bone after bone like butter. There is no telling just how many cadavers this bone saw has dissected.

name: Wall Sentinel Battle Rifle Variant
desc: A customization for battle rifles, in a style used by the watchful defenders of the Shield Wall against the incursions of raiders hailing from the Broken Lands.

name: Wall Sentinel Long Rifle Variant
desc: A customization for long rifles, in a style used by the watchful defenders of the Shield Wall against the incursions of raiders hailing from the Broken Lands.
